content.text:
I submitted **index 21 (Sb fraction 0.650)** as the best composition. At 0.0555% it had the highest EQE of the five compositions I measured, which used the whole EQE budget.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.305 | 0.0056 |
| 12 | 0.503 | 0.0116 |
| **21** | **0.650** | **0.0555** |
| 22 | 0.671 | 0.0463 |
| 27 | 0.709 | 0.0287 |

- **Trend:** EQE rises as the Sb fraction goes up and peaks just below 0.667. That is the Sb fraction of the known PbSb2O6 phase. EQE then falls at higher Sb fractions.
- **Not checked:** I never measured compositions below 0.30, between 0.30 and 0.50, or between 0.50 and 0.65. The model I used to suggest next measurements was still quite uncertain about Sb fractions of 0.57–0.62 (indices 18–20). A composition there could beat index 21.
- **No XRD used:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. So the link to PbSb2O6 is based only on the Sb fraction; no measured pattern confirms that phase is present.
